retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast radial composition featuring a central mechanical dial with glowing blue concentric rings and metallic textures.
excludeWhen: vintage analog styles without digital glow

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, top-down view of a stylized turntable platter and anti-skating dial, characterized by deep blue atmospheric lighting, glowing concentric circles, and sharp metallic highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric circles radiating from a central mechanical dial
High-contrast relationship between deep navy shadows and electric blue glows
Metallic chrome elements overlapping textured circular patterns
Heavy, wide sans-serif typography anchored to the top and bottom edges
coreInvariants: Radial symmetry centered on the dial
Electric blue and black color palette
Brushed metal texture on the central knob

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central dial and platter assembly occupy 80% of the frame, centered vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black anti-skating dial with white numerical markings.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central dial, follows the glowing blue rings outward, and then reads the horizontal text at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue nebulous clouds fill the corners, providing breathing room for the central graphic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Navy and Royal Blue (Background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and Chrome (Typography and mechanical details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark backgrounds and luminous highlights; high saturation in the blue spectrum.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red or orange
Limit to blues, blacks, and silver

letterConstructionRules: Square-off corners with slight rounding on outer edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' and 'C' follow a near-perfect circular outer path
The 'A' has a low horizontal crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use the same typeface family for all text, varying only by scale and weight for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Stippled texture on the outer platter ring

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tech-industrial aesthetic and wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down view of a futuristic turntable dial with concentric blue glowing rings, metallic textures, and a dark blue smoky background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay bold, ultra-extended geometric sans-serif text in white at the top and bottom, applying a subtle blue outer glow to the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-wide and uppercase?
Is the central dial the primary focal point?
Are the blue glows vibrant against the dark background?

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean vector-like edges on typography
avoid: Muddiness in the dark blue areas
Illegible overlapping of text and graphics

postGenerationChecks: Verify typography is centered and horizontally aligned
Check that the radial lines align with the center of the dial
Ensure the blue palette remains consistent across all elements
Confirm the metallic highlights look reflective
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial symmetry + Electric Blue Glow + Extended Geometric Sans + Metallic Textures = Techno-Futurist Aesthetic
